Area.evidence_source: A key factor running through accounts of the pathway to and from the attempt was that of coming to terms with getting older. This represented a struggle and provided the context for a subsequent intensification of struggle. Accounts were rich in stereotypes of old age, alongside beliefs and expectations about how old age should be managed. The ageist nature of many of these representations and stereotypes was striking: ... While the experience of ageing provided the context within which struggle was experienced, there was a marked intensification of struggle prior to the suicide attempt, the onset of which was marked by one or more turning points. ... Descriptions of an inner turmoil or inner battle were used to capture the intensification of the struggle immediately prior to the attempt: ...
